name: William Bergshrine
original_name: ウィリアム・ベルグシュライン
source:
A nearly emotionless warrior who has reached the pinnacle of swordsmanship.  Easily the strongest Paladin and Disciple.  He is the Apostle of Glenfarth.

[spoiler] A man who is the embodiment of being 'gifted'.  He has an immeasurable talent for battle, to the point where he can master sword techniques another master might take a lifetime to take in in the blink of an eye.  He is rational to the core, seeing his only purpose in existence to serve as a sword for his master.

Bergshrine is so talented that his combat ability surpasses even his master and the Gods while in his 40s. Befitting the sword of Veratyr, his loyalty is to Glenfarth alone and he will not hesitate to cut down the other Gods should the order be given.

His powers allow him to extend his sword slashes as far as his eye can see. Although it's no more than an extension of his attack range, his natural talent and skill make him the perfect living weapon for Glenfarth's desires. Even Jace acknowledges Adler's Murasame given immortality and Astral powers might not be Bergshrine's equal on the battlefield.[/spoiler]
